  • Method Details

    • getName

      @Nonnull String getName()
      Gets the display name of the listener.
      Returns:
      the name String of the listener, not null

    • overrideClaimingActionPermission

      @Nonnull ClaimActionPermissionOverride overrideClaimingActionPermission(@Nonnull UUID playerId, @Nonnull net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation dim, int x, int z, @Nonnull ClaimingAction action, @Nonnull IServerClaimsManagerAPI claimsManagerAPI, @Nonnull ClaimActionPermissionOverride currentOverride, @Nonnull net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Can be used to override usage permission for a claiming action. For example, stop a player from claiming unless they have enough of some sort of currency.

      When you have a reason to override the permission, you must create an instance of ClaimActionPermissionOverride and return it.

      When you don't have a reason to override the permission, it is recommended to simply return currentOverride instead of creating a new instance.

      Special claim owners can be found at SpecialClaimOwners, such as for server claims, in case you wish to handle such claims differently.

      Parameters:
      playerId - the UUID of the player who the action is being performed as, not null
      dim - the dimension ID of the chunk being affected
      x - the X chunk coordinate of the chunk being affected
      z - the Z chunk coordinate of the chunk being affected
      action - the claiming action type, not null
      claimsManagerAPI - the claims manager API, not null
      currentOverride - the current candidate to override the action permission with, not null
      server - the server, not null
      Returns:
      the claim action permission override instance, not null

    • handleSuccessfulClaimingAction

      void handleSuccessfulClaimingAction(@Nonnull UUID playerId, @Nonnull net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation dim, int x, int z, @Nonnull ClaimingAction action, @Nonnull IServerClaimsManagerAPI claimsManagerAPI, @Nonnull net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer server)
      Can be used to handle successful claiming actions.

      For example, if your addon is implementing a claiming cost system, this is where you would deduct the cost from the player.

      Special claim owners can be found at SpecialClaimOwners, such as for server claims, in case you wish to handle such claims differently.

      Parameters:
      playerId - the UUID of the player who the action is being performed as, not null
      dim - the dimension ID of the chunk that was affected
      x - the X in chunk coordinate space of the chunk that was affected
      z - the Z in chunk coordinate space of the chunk that was affected
      action - the claiming action type, not null
      claimsManagerAPI - the claim manager, not null
      server - the server, not null
